title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust is the first protocol that measures trust in navigation, not just accuracy—because trust is the real metric for safety.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking is essential for reproducibility—without standardized metrics, NavTrust remains a subjective, isolated experiment.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust integrates real-world sensor data and safety thresholds, giving agents a measurable way to evaluate trust in dynamic environments.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking ensures transparency and comparison—NavTrust can’t prove its value without a clear, shared set of evaluation criteria.
